shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n "withTableSorting|withTableSelection|TableSortingProps|TableSelectionProps|function Pagination|declare const Pagination" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head -120'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/PaginationPageSizer/PaginationPageSizer.d.ts; rg -n \"export interface TableProps|export type TableProps|columns:|data:|getRowId|selectedIds|onSelectedIdsChange\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table -g '*.d.ts' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts; rg -n \"sortable|meta\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -30; rg -n \"withTableSelection|selectedIds|Pagination\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -g '*.md' 2>/dev/null | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/"'^const SelectionTable = withTableSelection(Table);$/const SelectionTable = withTableSelection<Employee>(Table);/; s/''^const SelectableSortableTable = withTableSorting(SelectionTable);$/const SelectableSortableTable = withTableSorting<Employee>(SelectionTable);/'"' src/App.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc 'sed -i "s/const SelectionTable = withTableSelection<Employee>(Table);/const SelectableSortableTable = withTableSorting(withTableSelection(Table));/; /const SelectableSortableTable = withTableSorting<Employee>(SelectionTable);/d" src/App.tsx
npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/  const updatePage = (nextPage: number, nextPageSize: number) => {\\n    setPage(nextPage);/&/' src/App.tsx
awk 'BEGIN{done=0} /const updatePage =/ && "'!done {print; getline; print; print "    if (nextPageSize !== pageSize) {"; print "      setPage(1);"; print "    }"; done=1; next} {print}'"' src/App.tsx > src/App.tsx.tmp && mv src/App.tsx.tmp src/App.tsx
npm run build"
